uncertainty_scope: Conditional50/90% nearest-peak voltage crossing warp anchored at BASE054 mean peak and support ends; separate positive-area scales before/from reference mean peak+30. The split may introduce a seam; reference integrals are not native PSD guarantees. The target observed profile is not preADC truth; its crossings need not equal mean per-event crossings. Residual uses the same interpolation and deterministic linear front/tail integral projections. FIT only; covariance changes; conditional zero expectation is preserved only if it held in the original residual. Multiple crests and input event detail are retained, not replaced by a template.
